transcript.text: What is the single principle of business
you wish every entrepreneur understood
before they start?
>> The one thing
I think if I had to really boil it down
to one, it'd be volume. The amount of
volume and repetition that is required
to excel in any domain
is typically not twice as much or 10
times as much. It's usually in the order
of magnites of thousands of times as
much work and repetition as you think it
is. I think that is the fundamental
discrepancy that causes people to fail
is that they thought that I post one
time or I'll post 10 times and all of a
sudden I will become famous or I will
get viral or my marketing will work on
my 10th ad or my 10th door knock, my
10th email that I do outreach on that
the more experienced guys are like,
"Okay, how do I send 10,000 emails a day
and do that for 10 years?" It's hard to
fathom when you're starting out that
someone can actually do 10,000 times
more than you. But the people who are
10,000 times ahead of you, because there
are people 10,000 times richer than
people who are starting out, probably
did 10,000 times the repetition. And so
if you can do volume, lots of volume
with tremendous leverage, then you get
huge output.
